name: copilotprompts-prompt-m365-year-as-blockbuster-movie-poster-prompt
title: Turn your year into a blockbuster movie poster
shortDescription: Create a dramatic, funny movie poster inspired by your year, with a personalized title, tagline, genre, and visual highlights.
longDescription: Use Microsoft 365 Copilot to imagine your 2026 as a blockbuster movie. This prompt turns available context about your challenges, accomplishments, and personality into a cinematic poster with a hilarious title, a year-defining tagline, and an over-the-top genre. Adapt the year and provide non-sensitive context to personalize your own result.

thumbnails.alt: Example AI action-comedy poster titled Mission: Demo Possible, featuring April Dunnam with a microphone, a demo laptop, learning robots, and a Seattle skyline.
